title: Envelope Clip Picks
heading: The Envelope: pick one clip per card
intro: Two ways to animate each painted card (Omni 1.2 Flash, 8 s, camera locked; Premiere adds the push). S4's triangle is now over his eye and S3's notes are invented. Pick one per card and leave a note if it needs a re-roll.

groups.title: S1. The Counter
groups.line: The house opens: a smooth dealer offers two envelopes at even odds, like a fair bet.

groups.title: S2. The Pick
groups.line: The mark chooses in good faith; the host is all generosity.

opts.label: a: He presses down on one

groups.title: S3. The Switch
groups.line: The con revealed: whichever hat you pick, the same arms order sits under it, with fresh money on top.

opts.label: a: The swap
opts.warn: He sets both hats down rather than swapping them; the crate stencil reads ORDEN in places.

groups.title: S4. The Pay-off
groups.line: The sting: BadCode pulls the curtain and catches the house, both ties in one handshake over the rifles.

opts.label: b: The house is caught
opts.warn: The two men gain invented faces as they turn (they were faceless shadows); the handshake ends.
